### Added
- **The tool list follows a backend redeployed behind its Service.** A server's tools were read at registration and again only when the server sent `notifications/tools/list_changed` or its definition changed. A backend rolled to an image with another tool set does neither: the new process has never seen muster's session, so it notifies nobody, and the session recovery and the health probe heal the connection without re-reading the tools. The old list stayed until a restart -- a tool the new image dropped kept failing with `tool not found`, a tool it added stayed invisible. The aggregator now re-lists every connected server every `MUSTER_AGGREGATOR_CAPABILITY_POLL_INTERVAL` (default `5m`) and updates what changed, through the same refresh and the same notifications to clients as after a `list_changed`: a server with a shared client once, a server served per session through each session's own live connection into that session's list. Nothing is polled that is not connected, a listing that fails leaves the cached list as it is, and the log names the trigger (`Capability refresh (poll): updated 3 tools for <server>`). The harness's `test_redeploy_mock_server` gained `add_tools` and `remove_tools` -- a new image with another tool set, announced to nobody -- and two scenarios roll a backend that way and see the poll re-list it on the production schedule, for a shared connection and for a signed-in session's pooled one. ([#494](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/494))
